sanskrit_verse: महीपतीनां नाशौचं हतानां विद्युता तथा । गोब्राह्मणार्थं संग्रामे यस्य चेच्छति भूमिपः ॥
transliteration: mahīpatīnāṃ nāśaucaṃ hatānāṃ vidyutā tathā / gobrāhmaṇārthaṃ saṃgrāme yasya cecchati bhūmipaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: A king who engages in battle for the protection of cows and Brahmins, and whose soldiers fall in such combat, incurs no impurity thereby; nor does lightning strike those who die in such a dharmic war.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Dharma, not personal desire.
Causation is purified when action serves universal welfare (lokasaṅgraha).
Capacity-based responsibility includes intent rooted in protection of sacred life-values.
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration of societal integrity through righteous warfare.
Consciousness alignment occurs when the ruler's will merges with cosmic order (Ṛta).
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's intent == protection of cow AND Brahmin THEN death of soldier == no moral liability.
IF war cause == dharmic defense THEN posthumous ritual purification NOT required.
IF combatant dies in service of Dharma THEN natural forces (e.g., lightning) do NOT inflict karmic penalty.
IF military action violates cow/Brahmin protection THEN automatic judicial review mandated at highest tribunal.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any conflict involving national security must be evaluated based on whether it aligns with the sovereign duty to protect cows and Brahmins—the foundational pillars of civilizational continuity. The court must assess intent, proportionality, and alignment with Sanatana Dharma before affirming constitutional validity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causal purity overrides physical outcome. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential manifestation where dharmic intent neutralizes karmic consequence. Responsibility is proportional to alignment with Ṛta. There is no punitive inference because the act itself dissolves into the higher purpose.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Post-conflict completion process for families through Vedic consecration.
Reintegration of fallen warriors via ancestral invocation (pitṝnām upasthānam).
Ritual reaffirmation of king’s vow to uphold Gau-Brahmanya-Dharma.
Capacity restoration of kingdom through collective yajña performed by surviving citizens.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma-war bears no sin, for its fire consumes only falsehood. The slain are liberated, not punished. Consciousness alone judges, and in alignment with Dharma, all actions resolve into Supreme Order. Thus is justice restored without retribution.
